extraction.Name: William Curtis, Jr.
extraction.Recorded patent: The patent was recorded February 14, 1921 by D. A. Sinclair
extraction.Sold/Mortgaged: mortgaged by the allottee on February 11, 1921, then mortgaged by the heir on January 10, 1925 for $1,000
extraction.NOTES: Fee patent No. 739695 issued; Northwest quarter of Section 14, township 98, range [not fully legible]; receipt for patent signed by allottee on April 3, 1920; allottee is now deceased; heir is W. C. Curtis, a whiteman; probate record was recorded December 29, 1922; mortgage due January 10, 1927 and apparently still against the land
